name: table-viewer
description: Fast viewer for Excel, CSV and TSV
author: Jonathan Marc Bearak

commands.title: Table Viewer: Open Preview to the Side
Table Viewer: Open in Text Editor

tableViewer.fontFamily.description: Font family used in table views. Leave empty to use the editor font (editor.fontFamily).

tableViewer.fontSize.description: Font size in pixels used in table views. Set to 0 to follow the editor font size (editor.fontSize).

tableViewer.tabOrientation.description: Default worksheet tab orientation. Can be overridden per file.

tableViewer.maxStoredFiles.description: Maximum number of files whose layout settings (column widths, row heights, scroll positions) are remembered. When the limit is reached, the least recently used entries are removed first.

tableViewer.csvMaxRows.description: Maximum rows to display for CSV/TSV files. Excess rows are truncated with a banner.

tableViewer.maxFileSizeMiB.description: Maximum file size in MiB for all file types (xlsx, xls, csv, tsv).

scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:desktop && npm run typecheck:integration
scripts.pretest:integration: npm run bundle && npm run bundle:webview && npm run compile:integration
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run bundle && npm run bundle:webview
scripts.desktop:prepackage: npm run bundle:webview && npm run bundle:desktop && node desktop/collect-licenses.mjs
